S.FORM: tau nu kakwa amyan su avang tu titiwen kwan-da
S.PHON: tao no kakwa amjan ʂo afaŋ to titiwən kwanɖa
S.FORM: tao no kakoa amian so avang to titiwen koanda
S.PHON: ta[o|u] n[o|u] kak[o|u]a amian ʂ[o|u] afaŋ t[o|u] titiwən k[o|u]anɖa
S.TRANSL: A long time ago, there was a ship at Titiwen.

S.FORM: ma-chita-da tu madegdeg imurud nu tau
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa to maɖəgɖəg imoɻoɖ no tao
S.FORM: macitada to madegdeg imorod no tao
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa t[o|u] maɖəgɖəg im[o|u]ɻ[o|u]ɖ n[o|u] ta[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Early in the morning, the people from Imurud saw them (ship's crew).

S.FORM: ma-chita-da tu madegdeg tau d-imurud
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa to maɖəgɖəg tao ɖimoɻoɖ
S.FORM: macitada to madegdeg tao dimorod
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa t[o|u] maɖəgɖəg ta[o|u] ɖim[o|u]ɻ[o|u]ɖ
S.TRANSL: Early in the morning, the people from Imurud saw them (ship's crew).

S.FORM: ma-chita-da ipanchi-na u anak-na
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa ipanʨina o anakna
S.FORM: macitada ipancina o anakna
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa ipanʨina [o|u] anakna
S.TRANSL: The child said, "Look at them."

S.FORM: sira(unctn) mi-ripu-ripus mang-aep-tamu su matengteng utwen kwan-da
S.PHON: ʂiɻaon*tn miɻipoɻipoʂ maŋaəptamo ʂo matəŋtəŋ otwən kwanɖa
S.FORM: sira miriporipos mangaeptamo so matengteng otoen koanda
S.PHON: ɕiɻa miɻip[o|u]ɻip[o|u]ʂ maŋaəptam[o|u] ʂ[o|u] matəŋtəŋ [o|u]t[o|u]ən k[o|u]anɖa
S.TRANSL: His relatives said, "Let's take some cold food

S.FORM: ituru-tamu-dira kwan-da m-angay-tamu lu tatala kwan-da
S.PHON: itoɻotamoɖiɻa kwanɖa maŋajtamo lo tatala kwanɖa
S.FORM: itorotamodira koanda mangaytamo lo tatala koanda
S.PHON: it[o|u]ɻ[o|u]tam[o|u]ɖiɻa k[o|u]anɖa maŋajtam[o|u] l[o|u] tatala k[o|u]anɖa
S.TRANSL: to give them, and go over in our boat."

S.FORM: nun kwan-da m-angay-sira lu tatala m-angay titiwen.
S.PHON: non kwanɖa maŋajʂiɻa lo tatala maŋaj titiwən
S.FORM: non koanda mangaysira lo tatala mangay titiwen.
S.PHON: n[o|u]n k[o|u]anɖa maŋajɕiɻa l[o|u] tatala maŋaj titiwən
S.TRANSL: They went by boat to Titiwen,

S.FORM: ma-chita-da u avang nikumagat
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa o afaŋ nikomagat
S.FORM: macitada o avang nikomagat
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa [o|u] afaŋ nik[o|u]magat
S.TRANSL: and saw the wrecked ship.

S.FORM: tau nu avang mamimin-sira ni-m-angay lu katyan miwalem lu řerchip
S.PHON: tao no afaŋ mamiminʂiɻa nimaŋaj lo katjan miwaləm lo *əɻʨip
S.FORM: tao no avang mamiminsira nimangay lo katian miwalem lo řercip
S.PHON: ta[o|u] n[o|u] afaŋ mamiminɕiɻa nimaŋaj l[o|u] katian miwaləm l[o|u] *əɻʨip
S.TRANSL: All the people from the ship had gone to Katyan and were resting in the cave.

S.FORM: u tatala nu tau pangyiden-da
S.PHON: o tatala no tao paŋjiɖənɖa
S.FORM: o tatala no tao pangiidenda
S.PHON: [o|u] tatala n[o|u] ta[o|u] paŋiiɖənɖa
S.TRANSL: The newcomers with the food pulled the boat up on the shore.

S.FORM: k-aep-da su utwen-da-rana
S.PHON: kaəpɖa ʂo otwənɖaɻana
S.FORM: kaepda so otoendarana
S.PHON: kaəpɖa ʂ[o|u] [o|u]t[o|u]ənɖaɻana
S.TRANSL: The newcomers with the food pulled the boat up on the shore.

S.FORM: ma-chita-da nu dewdew ina-kamu-pa su kanen kwan-da
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa no ɖəwɖəw inakamopa ʂo kanən kwanɖa
S.FORM: macitada no dewdew inakamopa so kanen koanda
S.PHON: maʨitaɖa n[o|u] ɖəwɖəw inakam[o|u]pa ʂ[o|u] kanən k[o|u]anɖa
S.TRANSL: As soon as the foreigners saw it, they said, "Give us some food."

S.FORM: ipanchi nu tau i-kongu-kamu-ya chiri-chiring nu dewdew yamen va-vawden-inyu kwan-da
S.PHON: ipanʨi no tao ikoŋokamoja ʨiɻiʨiɻiŋ no ɖəwɖəw jamən fafawɖəninjo kwanɖa
S.FORM: ipanci no tao ikongokamoya ciriciring no dewdew yamen vavawdeninio koanda
S.PHON: ipanʨi n[o|u] ta[o|u] ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]kam[o|u]ja ʨiɻiʨiɻiŋ n[o|u] ɖəwɖəw jamən fafawɖənini[o|u] k[o|u]anɖa
S.TRANSL: The newcomers said, "Why are you here?" The foreigners replied, "You've come to bind us?"

S.FORM: chiri-chiring nu tau ning kwan-da nukumwanem vawden-tamu sira kwan-da
S.PHON: ʨiɻiʨiɻiŋ no tao niŋ kwanɖa nokomwanəm fawɖəntamo ʂiɻa kwanɖa
S.FORM: ciriciring no tao ning koanda nokomoanem vawdentamo sira koanda
S.PHON: ʨiɻiʨiɻiŋ n[o|u] ta[o|u] niŋ k[o|u]anɖa n[o|u]k[o|u]m[o|u]anəm fawɖəntam[o|u] ɕiɻa k[o|u]anɖa
S.TRANSL: "Yes, let's bind them,

S.FORM: k-aep-da su talili-da nu dewdew kwan-da
S.PHON: kaəpɖa ʂo taliliɖa no ɖəwɖəw kwanɖa
S.FORM: kaepda so talilida no dewdew koanda
S.PHON: kaəpɖa ʂ[o|u] taliliɖa n[o|u] ɖəwɖəw k[o|u]anɖa
S.TRANSL: and take their clothes," the newcomers said.

S.FORM: asa panisiringen-da kari ka-ma-kungu mu-ka-di-mi-lis-an kwan-da nu tau
S.PHON: aʂa paniʂiɻiŋənɖa kaɻi kamakoŋo mokaɖimiliʂan kwanɖa no tao
S.FORM: asa panisiringenda kari kamakongo mokadimilisan koanda no tao
S.PHON: aʂa paniɕiɻiŋənɖa kaɻi kamak[o|u]ŋ[o|u] m[o|u]kaɖimiliʂan k[o|u]anɖa n[o|u] ta[o|u]
S.TRANSL: One of them was the leader. The newcomer said, "Get out! Why don't you move?"

S.FORM: maniring u dewdew chyaa? di-kung-mi-lis
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ o ɖəwɖəw ʨjaaʔ ɖikoŋmiliʂ
S.FORM: maniring o dewdew ciaa dikongmilis
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ [o|u] ɖəwɖəw ʨiaa ɖik[o|u]ŋmiliʂ
S.TRANSL: The foreigner replied, "It doesn't make any difference whether I move or not. I won't move!"

S.FORM: u nak-nakem nu tau i-kungu na-di-mi-lis-i
S.PHON: o naknakəm no tao ikoŋo naɖimiliʂi
S.FORM: o naknakem no tao ikongo nadimilisi
S.PHON: [o|u] naknakəm n[o|u] ta[o|u] ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] naɖimiliɕi
S.TRANSL: Then they wondered, "Why doesn't he move?"

S.FORM: ala amyan su uvay-da kwan-a nu ama-da
S.PHON: ala amjan ʂo ofajɖa kwana no amaɖa
S.FORM: ala amian so ovayda koana no amada
S.PHON: ala amian ʂ[o|u] [o|u]fajɖa k[o|u]ana n[o|u] amaɖa
S.TRANSL: "I know he has some gold," said their father.

S.FORM: tuna-pi-lis-a kari kwan-a amyan su uvay-da lu lisnen-na amuri di-na-mi-lis-i
S.PHON: tonapiliʂa kaɻi kwana amjan ʂo ofajɖa lo liʂnənna amoɻi ɖinamiliʂi
S.FORM: tonapilisa kari koana amian so ovayda lo lisnenna amori dinamilisi
S.PHON: t[o|u]napiliʂa kaɻi k[o|u]ana amian ʂ[o|u] [o|u]fajɖa l[o|u] liʂnənna am[o|u]ɻi ɖinamiliɕi
S.TRANSL: Giving him a shove, he said, "Get out! There is some gold under his seat and that's why he doesn't move."

S.FORM: ma-chita-na nu ama-da tunang-aep-a tu ni-lisnen-a k-aep-na-rana-sya nu ama-da
S.PHON: maʨitana no amaɖa tonaŋaəpa to niliʂnəna kaəpnaɻanaʂja no amaɖa
S.FORM: macitana no amada tonangaepa to nilisnena kaepnaranasia no amada
S.PHON: maʨitana n[o|u] amaɖa t[o|u]naŋaəpa t[o|u] niliʂnəna kaəpnaɻanaɕia n[o|u] amaɖa
S.TRANSL: When the father saw it, he grabbed it from under the seat.

S.FORM: u panisiringen-da-m tu-rana-lavi ikapaw-na uvay-da ni-aep nu tau
S.PHON: o paniʂiɻiŋənɖam toɻanalafi ikapawna ofajɖa niaəp no tao
S.FORM: o panisiringendam toranalavi ikapawna ovayda niaep no tao
S.PHON: [o|u] paniɕiɻiŋənɖam t[o|u]ɻanalafi ikapawna [o|u]fajɖa niaəp n[o|u] ta[o|u]
S.TRANSL: The leader cried because he liked his gold that had been taken.

S.FORM: malalayu-rana sira m-angay lu tatala emragbit
S.PHON: malalajoɻana ʂiɻa maŋaj lo tatala əmɻagbit
S.FORM: malalayorana sira mangay lo tatala emragbit
S.PHON: malalaj[o|u]ɻana ɕiɻa maŋaj l[o|u] tatala əmɻagbit
S.TRANSL: They ran to the boat,

S.FORM: tiřarawa-kamu m-angay lu pik-il-ili-na
S.PHON: ti*aɻawakamo maŋaj lo pikililina
S.FORM: tiřarawakamo mangay lo pikililina
S.PHON: ti*aɻawakam[o|u] maŋaj l[o|u] pikililina
S.TRANSL: and went to their villages.
